basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old software developer from Portland, Oregon, with a passion for gaming, particularly strategic games like Slay the Spire. When I'm not coding or gaming, I enjoy exploring new music and supporting upcoming artists. I live with my partner and our two cats, and we love hosting game nights with friends. My typical online hours are in the evenings after work, usually from 7 PM to midnight. I'm always on the lookout for new streaming tips and tech gadgets to enhance my gaming experience.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've been gaming since I was a teenager, starting with card games and gradually moving to digital platforms. My expertise in strategy games is largely self-taught, bolstered by countless hours of gameplay and community engagement on forums and Reddit. Professionally, my background in software development has given me a strong analytical skill set, which I apply to both work and gaming.
